description.zh:
账号描述。
* 需以中文、英文字母开头，不能以`http: //`或`https: //`开头。
* 可以包含中文、英文字母、数字、下划线（_）和短划线（-）。 
* 长度为2~256个字符。
description.en:
The description of the account.

*   The description must start with a letter, and cannot start with `http://` or `https://`.
*   The description can contain letters, digits, underscores (\_), and hyphens (-).
*   The description must be 2 to 256 characters in length.

description.zh:
账号名，需满足以下条件：
* 以英文字母开头，由小写英文字母、数字或下划线（_）组成。
* 长度不超过100个字符。
* 不能为<props="china">[Redis账号名保留字](https://help.aliyun.com/zh/redis/user-guide/create-and-manage-database-accounts#section-u3q-817-om3)</props><props="intl">[Redis账号名保留字](https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/zh/redis/user-guide/create-and-manage-database-accounts#section-u3q-817-om3)</props>。
description.en:
The name of the account. The name must meet the following requirements:

*   The name must start with a lowercase letter and can contain lowercase letters, digits, and underscores (\_).
*   The name can be up to 100 characters in length.
*   The name cannot be one of the reserved words listed in the [Reserved words for Redis account names](https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/zh/redis/user-guide/create-and-manage-database-accounts#section-u3q-817-om3) section.

description.zh: 账号的密码。长度为8~32位，需包含大写字母、小写字母、特殊字符和数字中的至少三种，允许的特殊字符包括`!@#$%^&*()_+-=`。
description.en: The password of the account. The password must be 8 to 32 characters in length and must contain at least three of the following character types: uppercase letters, lowercase letters, digits, and specific special characters. These special characters include `! @ # $ % ^ & * ( ) _ + - =`

description.zh:
账号权限，取值：
* **RoleReadOnly**：只读权限。
* **RoleReadWrite**：读写权限，默认值。
description.en:
The permissions of the account. Valid values:

*   **RoleReadOnly**: The account has read-only permissions.
*   **RoleReadWrite**: The account has read and write permissions.

description.zh: 账号类型，取值固定为**Normal**（普通账号）。
description.en: The type of the account. Set the value to **Normal**, which indicates that the account is a standard account.

description.zh: 本参数仅用于内部维护，无需传入。
description.en: This parameter is used only for internal maintenance. You do not need to specify this parameter.

descriptions.zh:
* 该API仅支持兼容Redis 4.0及以上版本的实例；
 * 使用该API需要实例状态为运行中； 
 * 一个实例下最多可创建18个账号。
> 该API对应的控制台操作请参见[账号管理](~~92665~~)。
descriptions.en:
* This API supports only instances compatible with Redis 4.0 or later versions.  
* The instance must be in the running status to use this API.  
* You can create up to 18 accounts for an instance.  
> For the corresponding console operation, see [Account Management](~~92665~~).

example.unifiedCli: aliyun r-kvstore create-account --instance-id r-bp1zxszhcgatnx0000 --account-name demoaccount --account-privilege RoleReadOnly --account-password uWonno210000 --account-description testaccount --account-type Normal --source-biz SDK --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun r-kvstore CreateAccount --region cn-hangzhou --AccountDescription testaccount --InstanceId 'r-bp1zxszhcgatnx0000' --AccountPrivilege RoleReadOnly --AccountType Normal --SourceBiz SDK --AccountName demoaccount --AccountPassword uWonno210000
